title: BubblyDiscordLinker
body:
BubblyDiscordLinker

Professional Discord Account Verification System

Key Features
``` 1.Secure Linking: Use a 6-digit verification code to link accounts safely. 2.Auto-Roles: Automatically grant Discord roles upon successful linking. 3.Nickname Sync: Sync Discord nicknames with in-game Minecraft names automatically. 4.Auto-Cleaning: Keeps your verification channel clean by purging messages and user inputs. 5.Multi-Language Support: Supports English, Traditional Chinese (zh_tw), and Simplified Chinese (zh_cn). 6.Hierarchy Protection: Built-in safety checks to prevent errors when interacting with higher-ranked members. 7.Rich Embed Status: Display a professional discord embed in the verification channel to guide new user. 8.Bot Activity Presence: Customize what your bot is "Playing." "Watching." or "Listening to" directly from the config. 9.Addon Support: Easily extend functions with our official Addons. ```
